report.summary: Bulk discount calculation fails to apply the highest volume discount tier (20%) due to an off-by-one error in loop bounds.
report.root_cause: An optimization commit replaced direct iteration over the tiers list with an index-based loop using range(len(tiers) - 1). Because len(tiers) is 3, range(2) evaluates to indices 0 and 1, completely omitting the final tier index (20, 0.20). When 25 items are purchased, the system falls back to the 10% tier ($30.00 discount instead of the expected $60.00).

evidence.why_relevant: Demonstrates the off-by-one loop bounds that omit the final tier.
